plan.major: English and Writing Studies: Creative Writing Concentration
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), English and Writing Studies Major (BA) program page (poid=901), Creative Writing concentration. Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The recorded total is the major requirement only; the full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. The catalog states the major requires ten courses (minimum of 30 semester hours): three core courses plus seven courses in a concentration (minimum 21 semester hours), and that to be used toward the major each course must be taken for 3 or 4 semester hours. Residency as printed (re-verified live 2026-11-14): at least six of the 10 required courses, including ENGL 380, must be completed at Salem. The core's ENGL 214 is the cross-listed ENGL 214 / HHMN 214 course, counted once. Catalog typos transcribed as printed in titles: ENGL 365 'Natative' [sic]; ENGL 250's GenEd line prints 'Service Learnng' [sic]. Concentration notes as printed: a maximum of three semester hours of internship (ENGL 270 or CRWR 270) can be used as an elective toward the concentration, and typically a maximum of two independent or two honors independent studies can be used as electives, each taken for a minimum of 3 semester hours; exceptions require the program director's approval. The Workshop choose-one prerequisites are printed on the detail pages (CRWR 313 requires CRWR 217; CRWR 321 requires CRWR 218; both prerequisite courses are fixed in this plan) and are disclosed on the slot, not recorded, per the choice-slot precedent. In the Reading and Writing list the catalog prints two OR pairs as single entries (ENGL 245 or ENGL 246; ENGL 249 or ENGL 299); both members of each pair are listed as options here. ENGL 105 / HHMN 105 and ENGL 365 / REST 365 are cross-listed pairs, listed as printed. The Reading and Writing heading prints '3 hours each' although one listed option, CRWR 315 The Art and Act of Revision, is printed at 4 Hour(s) on its detail page; it is disclosed on the slots, not listed as a fixed 3-credit option. The recorded total (30) is core 9 + concentration 21, the catalog's printed minimum.

courses.title: Intermediate Workshop
courses.choice_note: Choose one: CRWR 313 Intermediate Fiction Workshop (3 Hour(s), prerequisite CRWR 217) or CRWR 321 Intermediate Poetry Workshop (3 Hour(s), prerequisite CRWR 218). Both prerequisite courses are fixed in this plan; the prerequisites are disclosed here, not recorded on the slot, per the choice-slot precedent.

courses.title: Reading and Writing
courses.choice_note: Choose three courses in total for this part of the Reading and Writing block (this is one of the three choice slots); at least two of the block's four courses must be in literature, as printed. Options listed at the slot's exercised 3 credits, in the catalog's printed order. Options in the catalog list at other credits, disclosed not listed as fixed options: CRWR 200 Independent Study in Creative Writing (1-4 Hour(s), 2.0 GPA prerequisite), CRWR 220 Special Topics Creative Writing (1-4), CRWR 270 Internship in Creative Writing (1-4, 2.0 GPA), CRWR 290 Honors Independent Study Creative Writing (3-4, 3.5 GPA), CRWR 315 The Art and Act of Revision (4 Hour(s), prerequisite one writing intensive course).
